INTRO_KR: Zhang Guanglie, the founder of Sichuan Ya'an Zhougongshan Tea Industry Co., Ltd., is the inheritor of the Zhougongshan Zhang family's tea-making tradition. The Zhougongshan mountain range where the company is located has long been a core raw material production area for South Road tea. Established in 1992, the company has a continuous production history of over 33 years of Tibetan tea. It is a designated national enterprise for ethnic minority special needs, a leading enterprise in agricultural industrialization in Sichuan Province, and a model unit for ethnic unity and progress in Sichuan Province. It has also passed the ISO9001 quality management system certification and organic product certification. The company has 5,900 mu of high-altitude ecological tea gardens, with an altitude of about 800 to 1,200 meters. The tea gardens are distributed at the foot of Zhougongshan Mountain and have always been a core raw material production area for Tibetan tea. In 2018, the company's Zhougongshan Mountain tea garden base and Madashan tea garden base were rated as "High-altitude Ecological Tea Tree Resource Bases". In 2024, the Zhougongshan Mountain tea garden base was rated as "China's Beautiful Tea Mountain" by China National Geography.

NAME_KR: Sri Lanka Tea Board
NAME_EN: Sri Lanka Tea Board
INTRO_KR: Sri Lanka Tea Board is the apex government body responsible for development of Sri Lanka tea industry and promotion of Ceylon Tea globally. Sri Lanka produces one of the best quality teas in the world called Ceylon Tea which is the most sought after tea by the tea connoisseurs around the globe. The country produces over 250 million of kilos of tea per annum which consist of Orthodox Black Tea, CTC Tea, Green Tea, Organic Teas, Artisanal Teas, RTDs etc and exports to over 150 destinations around the world in different forms of packaging. Ceylon Tea comes from seven agro-climatic regions of Sri Lanka namely Nuwara Eliya, Uda Pussellawa, Dimbula, Uva, Kandy, Sabaragamuwa and Ruhuna. The tea produced in these regions give completely different tea experience for the tea lovers as each region has its own tea characters in connection with its color, aroma, flavor and strength as result of the diverse soil and climatic condition in each region. In the basket of Ceylon Tea, over 30 tea grades are available to meet the different global tea requirement of overseas buyers. Sri Lanka Tea Board has taken many steps to ensure that all teas produced and exported from Sri Lanka adhere to the minimum quality standards of ISO 3720. The promotion of Ceylon tea linked to the Lion Logo.
